rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and thinned zona, but it overstates confidence about early hatching/exfoliation and gives limited image-grounded detail on ICM/TE beyond what is already supplied by the Gardner grade.

Integrates age, prior live birth, ovarian response, semen parameters, BMI, diagnosis, and lifestyle reasonably well with embryo quality, though AMH is unavailable and some factors are discussed more generally than specifically.

Overall logical and structured, but there is a notable inconsistency in treating a 15 mm endometrium as the main negative factor while still placing prognosis in the upper-middle of the stated implantation range; prior cycle history is also interpreted somewhat ambiguously.

Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer and cautious use of add-on therapies, but it overemphasizes 15 mm endometrial thickness as a negative modifier and suggests extra concern/interventions that are not clearly guideline-driven in an otherwise suitable transfer.
Provides practical next steps for proceeding with transfer, SET, luteal/endometrial review, and escalation only after repeated failure; recommendations are useful though some are somewhat generic.
